BGP Large Community Policy – Route Server AS154034

The route server (RS) recognizes and acts on the following large-community values.

General syntax:
154034:<action-code>:<peer-ASN>
Replace <peer-ASN> with the destination ASN (examples below use 65500 as a placeholder).

0 | Global Reject | Any prefix that carries 154034:0:0 is rejected. ---> 154034:0:0

0 | Per-Peer Reject | A prefix that carries 154034:0:<peer> is rejected only when exported to that specific peer ASN. ---> 154034:0:<Peer-AS>

1 | Announce a route to a certain peer | Allow the prefix to be advertised to a designated peer. ---> 154034:1:<Peer-AS>

101 | Prepend x1 | The RS prepends ASN 154034 once to the AS-PATH before sending the route to the peer. ---> 154034:101:<Peer-AS>

102	| Prepend x2 | The RS prepends ASN 154034 twice to the AS-PATH. ---> 154034:102:<Peer-AS>

103	| Prepend x3 | The RS prepends ASN 154034 three times to the AS-PATH. ---> 154034:103:<Peer-AS>
